user.title: HuaweiHome Bridge
user.description:
Welcome to HuaweiHome Bridge!

This integration bridges your Home Assistant devices to Huawei Smart Life ecosystem, enabling control via Huawei Smart Life app or voice assistant.

**Features:**

- Map HA devices to Huawei HiLink ecosystem

- Support remote control and voice control

- Support various device types

**Usage Steps:**

1.After completing this configuration, the gateway will start automatically

2.Click "Configure" button to get PIN code

3.Enter the PIN code in Huawei Smart Life app to complete binding

---

Click "Submit" button below to complete integration setup

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed

progress.wait_for_binding:
Please enter the following PIN code in Huawei Smart Life app to complete binding

### 🔐 PIN Code: **{pin_code}**

⏰ Valid for: **{time_out} minutes**

---

**Binding Steps:**

1.Open Huawei Smart Life app

2.Tap '+' → Add Device

3.Select 'Gateway' → Enter PIN code

4.Input the PIN shown above

5.Wait for binding success

---

**Important Notes:**

-Please complete binding within **{time_out} minutes**

-PIN code expires after timeout, please reconfigure

abort.pin_expired: PIN code has expired, please reconfigure

notify.restart_message: HuaweiHome Bridge has been removed. If you want to re-add this integration, please restart Home Assistant first, otherwise the integration will not work properly.
